DISPUTED — reverses part of Task C's MAJOR-02 correction. Mutation replaces self._feature_subject_id with None in the INTERMEDIATE CATCHING_UP OwnerHandle set immediately before _catch_up() executes; unconditionally overwritten by the correct ACTIVE handle if _catch_up succeeds. MAJOR-02 argued the public .handle/.state read-only properties make this intermediate state 'concurrently observable' and therefore material. This audit's STRICTER re-evaluation finds: (1) AuthoritativeSubjectOwner's own class docstring documents no thread-safety contract and contains no lock -- the class is architected as a single-owner-per-subject coordinator ('the ONLY thing authorized to drive that engine's authoritative path'), which is the opposite of a design intended for concurrent multi-reader access to in-flight mutable state; (2) no ADR-043 clause, feature.md section, or module docstring documents a governed guarantee that .handle/.state must be internally-consistent during an in-flight acquire_and_activate call observed from another thread; (3) constructing a deterministic test for this window requires artificially injecting a synchronization point into a private collaborator (e.g. monkeypatching _catch_up/_history_provider to block on a threading.Event) purely to manufacture an observation window the production design does not promise to keep correct, which edges toward the prohibited 'contrived fixture construction' anti-gaming rule rather than testing a genuine documented contract. This is a genuine, material disagreement with a PRIOR formally-approved correction (MAJOR-02) and is NOT resolved by this transaction -- recorded as UNCLEAR/DISPUTED pending a separate, distinct-principal Review A. This audit does not modify the currently-ACTIVE 42-ID artifact or unilaterally reclassify this pair.

feature_engine.swing_distance.x__total_o.reasoning: -state.revision -> +state.revision (criterion 6 of the documented 8-criterion deterministic total order). Unreachable as a discriminator: criteria 3 and 5 of the same key tuple (state.ref.stream_id, state.ref.sequence) already uniquely identify the confirming event for any given swing_id (EventRecordRef is the durable unique identity of one committed event throughout this codebase, e.g. p_run_sort's own by_ref dedup/ConflictingUpstreamEnvelopeError). Two DIFFERENT candidate (swing_id, state) pairs in _select_eligible_swing's candidate list can therefore never tie on stream_id+sequence, so tuple comparison always resolves (or fails to resolve, i.e. never reaches) position 6 before criterion 5. Comparison short-circuits at the first differing element, so this mutation is never observably compared for genuinely distinct candidates.

feature_engine.swing_distance.xǁSwingDis.reasoning: max(candle.recorded_time, state.recorded_time, cursor.recorded_time) drops the state.recorded_time term. The function's own comment states the floor deliberately includes cursor.recorded_time to guarantee computation_cursor.recorded_time <= FeatureComputed.recorded_time 'never merely evidence-derived' -- explicitly treating state.recorded_time (the used Swing's own recorded_time) as an independent, non-redundant evidence term. Reachable/material via a swing state whose recorded_time strictly exceeds both candle.recorded_time and cursor.recorded_time; the resulting recorded_time_floor differs observably (assertable directly on prepared.prepared_events[0].recorded_time_floor, a real structural field, not message text).
Same 3-way max() floor pattern and same reachability argument as _prepare_original__mutmut_13, in the preempt-settled-window path.
Same 3-way max() floor pattern and same reachability argument as _prepare_original__mutmut_13, in the replacement-only path.

`assert correction_ref is not None and correction_recorded_time is not None` mutated to `or`. This internal invariant assert exists specifically to catch a caller supplying an inconsistent correction_ref/correction_recorded_time pair before entering _prepare_invalidate_and_replace, which consumes both. Under the mutation, a caller supplying exactly one of the two (not both) would incorrectly pass the assert and proceed with a None value threaded into a path that expects a real ref/time, an observable divergence testable via a direct call to the private method with a deliberately mismatched pair. Medium confidence: full downstream crash-site was not exhaustively traced in this pass; recommended for confirmation during implementation.

`continue` -> `break` inside the per-window re-evaluation loop (`for key, lineage in list(self._lineage.items())`), on the branch reached when an invalidated/PENDING_CORRECTION window still has no eligible Swing. Mutated to break, the ENTIRE loop stops as soon as ONE such window is encountered, silently skipping any subsequent window that legitimately needed re-evaluation. Reachable via >=2 lineage entries where the first (in insertion order) hits this branch and a second entry would otherwise produce a PreparedTransition -- a legitimate, non-contrived two-window scenario.

_total_order_key(item[0], item[1]) -> _total_order_key(None, item[1]) — replaces swing_id (criterion 7 of 8) with None. Even less reachable than mutmut_3 above (criterion 6): reaching criterion 7 as a discriminator additionally requires criterion 6 (state.revision) to also tie, a strict superset of the already-impossible-for-distinct-candidates precondition established for _total_order_key__mutmut_3 (stream_id+sequence uniqueness). min()'s tuple comparison never reaches this position for genuinely distinct candidates, and a single-candidate call never triggers any pairwise comparison at all (min() returns the sole item unconditionally).

state.pivot_effective_time[0] -> state.pivot_effective_time[1] in the eligibility filter `state.pivot_effective_time[0] < reference_cutoff`. pivot_effective_time is a real (start, end) datetime tuple; using the window END instead of START for the eligibility comparison is a materially different, easily reachable defect (construct a candidate whose start is before reference_cutoff but whose end is not, or vice versa) -- no unreachability argument applies here, unlike the tie-break-only mutants above.

root_cause_of_prior_misclassification.description: mutmut's mutator for type(X)-style diagnostic expressions replaces the ARGUMENT inside type(...) with None (producing type(None)), not the whole call with a bare None. type(None).__name__ == 'NoneType' is a valid string so the same exception TYPE is raised either way -- only the reported type-name substring in the message changes. The post-E005 diagnostic assumed a whole-call replacement (crash via AttributeError) without inspecting the precise extracted diff, over-classifying 9 Cluster-A identities as GENUINE_TEST_GAP.
root_cause_of_prior_misclassification.corrective_recommendation: Before classifying any mutation touching a type()/isinstance()-style diagnostic expression as GENUINE_TEST_GAP, always inspect the exact extracted CST diff (original_node vs mutated_node), never infer the mutated shape from the source line alone.

root_cause_of_prior_misclassification.description: Three None -> '' sentinel-default mutations (_finalize_prepared_batch__mutmut_3/_4, _validate_canonical_recorded_time__mutmut_1) were left in the untested Wave-6 population without any reachability tracing across any prior transaction, despite being reachable in one hop from an `is None` guard whose bypass produces an observable different exception type. This audit found all three genuinely material on first inspection.
root_cause_of_prior_misclassification.corrective_recommendation: Any None -> '' or None -> 0 sentinel-default mutation deserves a mandatory one-hop trace of every `is None` check on that same local before it is classified at all.

root_cause_of_prior_misclassification.description: Two mutations targeting the 6th/7th criteria of an 8-criterion deterministic total order (swing revision, swing_id) were left unclassified in Wave-6. Tracing the invariant that EventRecordRef (stream_id+sequence) is the durable unique identity of one committed event throughout this codebase shows criteria 3+5 already fully discriminate any two genuinely distinct candidates, making criteria 6/7 provably unreachable as comparison discriminators.
root_cause_of_prior_misclassification.corrective_recommendation: For any mutation inside a multi-criterion deterministic ordering/tie-break key, trace whether an EARLIER criterion in the same key already uniquely discriminates every legitimately-distinct input before assuming a later criterion is reachable.

root_cause_of_prior_misclassification.description: Task C's MAJOR-02 correction reclassified acquire_and_activate__mutmut_21/_23 as GENUINE_TEST_GAP on the basis that the public .handle/.state properties make an in-flight intermediate CATCHING_UP OwnerHandle 'concurrently observable'. This audit's stricter re-check finds AuthoritativeSubjectOwner documents no thread-safety contract, has no lock, and is architected as a single-owner-per-subject coordinator -- the observability argument was not grounded in any documented governed contract, and manufacturing a deterministic test for it requires injecting artificial synchronization into a private collaborator.
root_cause_of_prior_misclassification.corrective_recommendation: A 'concurrent observability' materiality argument must point to an explicit documented concurrency/thread-safety contract (ADR clause, class docstring, or feature.md section) before being accepted -- the mere existence of a public read-only property is not sufficient, and this is now an explicitly disputed, unresolved finding pending independent review.

root_cause_of_prior_misclassification.description: identity.x_deterministic_id__mutmut_3 was killed via a golden SHA-256 digest pin in Wave-5 and implicitly counted as a resolved genuine gap purely because a real targeted mutmut run showed it killed. identity.py's own module docstring explicitly states the concrete algorithm is a module-local implementation detail, not a Domain Contract, and that feature.md Sec19 requires only opaque/stable/deterministic/collision-resistant -- none of which this specific mutation (a wider separator) actually violates.
root_cause_of_prior_misclassification.corrective_recommendation: A killed mutant must still be checked against the function/module's own documented contract before being counted as a genuine gap -- 'the test now kills it' is necessary but not sufficient; the assertion must be shown to test something the contract actually promises, not merely something the current implementation happens to produce.
